sn22.52:1.2: “Bhikkhus, attend carefully to form. Recognize the impermanence of form as it really is. When a bhikkhu attends carefully to form and recognizes the impermanence of form as it really is,
sn22.52:1.4: With the destruction of delight comes the destruction of lust; with the destruction of lust comes the destruction of delight.
sn22.52:1.5: With the destruction of delight and lust the mind is liberated and is said to be well liberated.
sn22.52:1.18: With the destruction of delight and lust the mind is liberated and is said to be well liberated.”
